Lucario

Fighting Steel

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Lucario is a Fighting/Steel-type Aura Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 54 kg. It evolves from Riolu. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (115), with a base stat total of 525.
